newsitem.title: UK: NWE JET BARGES TRADE EASIER, CARGOES INACTIVE.
newsitem.headline: NWE JET BARGES TRADE EASIER, CARGOES INACTIVE.

text.p: North-west European jet fuel prices were mixed in small volume on Tuesday, traders said.
Outright values firmed. September IPE last traded $1 stronger at $170.75 a tonne after an uneventful August expiry.
Two barges of 2,000 tonnes each went to a European airline and another buyer at September IPE +$18.00 fob ARA, some 50 cents adrift from Monday's traded value.
Cargoes cif were notionally steady at around $17 over September IPE, with EU material in the Med assessed at $7 to Med fob high quotations.
